    39	    start_input: Expr,
    40	    done_release: Expr,

    43	    let done = sig.done_expr();
    44	    let ready = Expr::ident(sig.ready_name());

    92	                        }],

   141	/// FIFO's internal signal names (`fifo_name + suffix`) to the parent
   142	/// module's port names (`fifo_name + suffix`). The internal and external
   143	/// names are the same — the parent module already has these as ports.

   147	///   the external side (the parent port drives the internal wire)
   148	/// - Output suffixes (`_read`, `_din`, `_write`): these are driven by

   152	/// the child instance portargs connect directly to the parent ports.
   153	/// This function returns assigns only when the FIFO internal name
   154	/// differs from the parent port name (e.g., renamed FIFOs).
   155	pub fn build_external_fifo_assigns(
   156	    internal_name: &str,
   157	    external_name: &str,
   158	    is_consumed: bool,
   159	) -> Vec<ContinuousAssign> {
   160	    let internal_name = sanitize_array_name(internal_name);
   161	    let external_name = sanitize_array_name(external_name);
   162	    if internal_name == external_name {
   163	        return Vec::new(); // Names match, no assigns needed
   164	    }
   165	
   166	    let suffixes: &[&str] = if is_consumed {
   167	        ISTREAM_SUFFIXES
   168	    } else {
   169	        OSTREAM_SUFFIXES
   170	    };
   171	
   172	    suffixes
   173	        .iter()
   174	        .map(|suffix| {
   175	            let is_input_dir = STREAM_PORT_DIRECTION
   176	                .get(suffix)
   177	                .is_some_and(|&d| d == "input");
   178	
   179	            if is_input_dir {
   180	                ContinuousAssign::new(
   181	                    Expr::ident(format!("{internal_name}{suffix}")),
   182	                    Expr::ident(format!("{external_name}{suffix}")),
   183	                )
   184	            } else {
   185	                ContinuousAssign::new(
   186	                    Expr::ident(format!("{external_name}{suffix}")),
   187	                    Expr::ident(format!("{internal_name}{suffix}")),
   188	                )
   189	            }
   190	        })
   191	        .collect()
   192	}

   234	            PortArg::new("m_axis_tready", Expr::ident(format!("{fifo_name}_TREADY"))),

     2	//!
     3	//! Cuts are formed over the regions used by the *current* partition iteration,
     4	//! rather than always over atomic slots. That distinction lets the same
     5	//! placement ILP be reused for the row-level and column-level passes of
     6	//! multilevel placement.

    10	/// A clean bipartition of the current candidate regions.
    11	#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
    12	pub struct Cut {
    13	    /// Cut label, e.g. `y=0` (row boundary) or `x=1` (column boundary).
    14	    pub name: String,
    15	    /// Regions on the down/left side.
    16	    pub lhs: Vec<Coor>,
    17	    /// Regions on the up/right side.
    18	    pub rhs: Vec<Coor>,
    19	    /// Allowed crossing width: Python `round(0.7 * raw_capacity)`.
    20	    pub capacity: u64,
    21	}

    24	/// rounding. The multiplication intentionally happens in binary64 first:
    25	/// Python evaluates `45 * 0.7` just below 31.5 and therefore rounds it to 31.

    29	    clippy::cast_sign_loss,
    30	    clippy::cast_precision_loss,
    31	    reason = "the formulation computes round(integer_capacity * 0.7) in binary64"
    32	)]

    34	    debug_assert!(
    35	        (USABLE_WIRE_RATIO - 0.7).abs() < f64::EPSILON,
    36	        "ratio drifted"
    37	    );
    38	
    39	    (raw as f64 * USABLE_WIRE_RATIO).round_ties_even() as u64
    40	}

    75	            .copied()
    76	            .filter(|region| region.ur_y <= y)
    77	            .collect();
    78	        let rhs: Vec<Coor> = regions
    79	            .iter()
    80	            .copied()
    81	            .filter(|region| region.dl_y > y)
    82	            .collect();
    83	        push_if_clean_and_binding(device, regions, &mut cuts, format!("y={y}"), lhs, rhs);
    84	    }

    87	        let lhs: Vec<Coor> = regions
    88	            .iter()
    89	            .copied()
    90	            .filter(|region| region.ur_x <= x)
    91	            .collect();
    92	        let rhs: Vec<Coor> = regions
    93	            .iter()
    94	            .copied()
    95	            .filter(|region| region.dl_x > x)
    96	            .collect();
    97	        push_if_clean_and_binding(device, regions, &mut cuts, format!("x={x}"), lhs, rhs);
    98	    }

   101	}

   107	    name: String,
   108	    lhs: Vec<Coor>,
   109	    rhs: Vec<Coor>,

   113	    }

   119	        .map(|(left, right)| border_capacity(device, left, right))
   120	        .sum();
